ci_support_linux_64_python3.11.____cpyth:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
name: rift
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: RIFT
  version: "0.0.17.13"

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name | lower }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 865c6eab6c2738f93bc2ba10b278dc3e8ec554c3eec00fc9c10fc6bf59ae7c28
  patches:
    # remove extraneous data_files setting
    - remove_data_files.patch

build:
  number: 1
  skip:
    - not unix
    # scipy <1.16 is incompatible with python >=3.14
    - match(python, ">=3.14")

outputs:
  - package:
      name: rift
    build:
      python:
        skip_pyc_compilation:
          - bin/*.py
      script:
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vvv
        - rm -rf ${{ PREFIX }}/bin/__pycache__/
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - python
      host:
        - pip
        - python
        - setuptools
      run:
        - corner
        - gwdatafind
        - gwpy
        - h5py
        - igwn-ligolw
        - igwn-segments
        - lalsuite
        - ligo.skymap
        - matplotlib-base
        - numba >=0.56
        - numpy
        - pandas
        - precession
        - python
        - scikit-learn
        - scipy <1.16
        - six
        - natsort
        - python-htcondor
    tests:
      - requirements:
          run:
            # Work around issue with healpy metadata
            - if: osx
              then: numpy >=2.0.0
        python:
          imports:
            - RIFT
            - RIFT.integrators
            - RIFT.interpolators
            - RIFT.likelihood
            - RIFT.physics
      - script:
          env:
            EOB_ARCHIVE: "$(pwd)"
            EOB_BASE: ""
            EOB_C_BASE: "$(pwd)"
            EOB_C_ARCHIVE: "$(pwd)"
            EOB_C_ARCHIVE_NMAX: "1"
            EOS_TABLES: "$(pwd)"
            GW_SURROGATE: "$(pwd)"
            MATLAB_BASE: "$(pwd)"
            MPLBACKEND: "agg"
          content:
            - convergence_test_samples.py --help
            - convert_dat_to_hdf5.py --help
            - convert_output_format_ile2inference --help
            - convert_output_format_inference2ile --help
            - convert_psd_ascii2xml --help
            - create_event_parameter_pipeline_BasicIteration --help
            - create_postprocessing_event_dag.py --help
            - helper_LDG_Events.py --help
            - integrate_likelihood_extrinsic --help
            - integrate_likelihood_extrinsic_batchmode --help
            - integrate_likelihood_extrinsic_no-op --help
            - plot_posterior_corner.py --help
            - util_AdaptiveExponent.py --help
            - util_CoincIFOUtility.py --help
            - util_ConstructIntrinsicPosterior_GenericCoordinates.py --help
            - util_EstimateWaveformDuration.py --help
            - util_FrameZeroNoiseSNR.py --help
            - util_GenerateMaxlnLWaveform.py --help
            - util_GridRecenter.py --help
            - util_ILENextGeneration.py --help
            - util_IterativeFisher.py --help
            - util_JoinXML.py --help
            - util_LALCompareApproximantsOnSamples.py --help
            - util_LALWriteFrame.py --help
            - util_ManualOverlapGrid.py --help
            - util_MarginalizedLikelihoodEOSIntegralFromIntermediate.py --help
            - util_MassGrid.py --help
            - util_MassGridCoalesce.py --help
            - util_ParameterFilter.py --help
            - util_ParameterPuffball.py --help
            - util_ParameterRandomize.py --help
            - util_PrintInjection.py --help
            - util_ROMWriteFrame.py --help
            - util_ResampleILEOutputWithExtrinsic.py --help
            - util_TestSpokesIO.py --help
            - util_TestXMLParameterStorage.py --help
            - util_TidalPlotSimulationStrain.py --help
            - util_WriteInjectionFile.py --help

  - package:
      name: rift-gpu
    build:
      skip:
        - not linux
    requirements:
      host:
        - python
      run:
        - cupy
        - python
        - pytorch
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('rift', exact=True) }}
    about:
      summary: RIFT parameter estimation pipeline GPU metapackage
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - RIFT.interpolators.interp_gpu

about:
  summary: RIFT parameter estimation pipeline
  homepage: https://git.ligo.org/rapidpe-rift/rift
  repository: https://git.ligo.org/rapidpe-rift/rift.git
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.md

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - duncanmmacleod
    - jlange2010
    - oshaughn
